item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (76)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 76

  • Right-click a folder to find copies by file content, including subfolders.
  • The oldest copy that opens stays. The other copies move to Archive.
  • A file that does not open stays where it is.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes
